title: CascadeFixtureFile
description: JSON envelope for weather-cascade fixture files. Cascade is the only tier-1 module whose fixtures need JSON (vs. CSV) — the nested replay 'responses' array and tree-structured 'expectedAudit.children' don't serialize cleanly to CSV. Each file describes one cascade scenario as a single fixture row with mocked HTTP responses.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this meta-schema; usually 'https://heat-engine.spec/tier1/cascade-fixtures.schema.json'.

spec_version.description: Spec version this fixture is pinned to. Conformance tests assert this matches the runtime SPEC_VERSION.

module.description: Always 'cascade' for files under this schema.

source_citations.description: Where this fixture's expected behavior comes from (e.g., 'api.weather.gov + api.open-meteo.com cascade order').

rows.description: One or more fixture rows. Cascade replay scenarios typically have exactly one row per file.

id.description: Stable identifier for this row, used in test names and CHANGELOG entries.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this scenario exercises.

clock_iso.description: Pinned clock the conformance test injects via SpecContext.

responses.description: Replay HTTP responses for the httpAdapter; matched in order against outgoing requests by url_pattern regex.

ctx.description: Test-time context: clock + replay responses. The runtime adapter walks the responses list and serves the first url_pattern match.

expectedResult.description: Expected CascadeResult shape, or null if the cascade is expected to fail catastrophically (e.g., all sources timeout under a zero-budget ctx).

expectedAudit.description: Expected AuditRecord byte-equal via canonicalJson. Tree-structured: children[] should mirror the source_chain.

url_pattern.description: Regex matched against the outgoing request URL. First match wins.

body_json.description: JSON-encodable response body. Mutually exclusive with body_text.

body_text.description: Raw response body (useful for malformed-JSON scenarios). Mutually exclusive with body_json.

simulate.description: When set, the adapter simulates the named failure mode instead of returning a response.
